name: More Sparklematic Action
summary: In Gnomeregan, the Sparklematic 5200 still cleans what can be saved. Left behind when the city was evacuated, it scrubs muck and radioactive sludge from curiosities for a small fee in silver.

sections.title: Automated Restoration
sections.body: Before the trogg invasion and the fallout that followed, Gnomeregan's engineers installed automated devices throughout the city. Toxic waste and hostile automatons now fill its corridors. Yet the Sparklematic 5200 follows its exact programming: it needs three silver coins and an artifact caked in grime to begin.

sections.title: Wonders from the Muck
sections.body: The Sparklematic lurches as it sprays an inserted relic with potent gnomish solvents and scrubs it clean. A cheerful chime marks the end of the cycle, and the machine dispenses a neatly packaged box. Inside is whatever salvage remained beneath corrosive trogg slime and toxic filth.

faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200 is an automated gnomish cleaning device inside Gnomeregan. It strips caustic sludge, grime, and radioactive residue from recovered objects, leaving salvage that can be identified.

faq.q: Why does the machine charge coins?
faq.answer: The Sparklematic needs three silver coins to begin a cleaning cycle. No reason for the charge is given.

faq.q: What kinds of objects can be put inside?
faq.answer: The machine cleans grime-encrusted objects, including relics recovered from fallen troggs, corrupted sentries, and irradiated horrors in Gnomeregan's tunnels.

faq.q: Is the Sparklematic safe from radiation?
faq.answer: Radioactive waste fills Gnomeregan's exterior tunnels, but the Sparklematic 5200 still works. Its specialized gnomish cleaning agents scrub dangerous residue from incoming objects.

faq.q: Can both factions use the Sparklematic 5200?
faq.answer: Yes. The Sparklematic 5200 is an automated mechanical installation that accepts payment and grime-encrusted items from visitors of either allegiance.
The Sparklematic's creator is not named. The gnomish cleaning machine still works inside Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see your people's mechanical endurance in the Sparklematic, still working amid the toxic ruins of your homeland.
As an engineer, you can study the device's sturdy gnomish solvent cycles and coin-activated mechanisms firsthand.
